description: This file defines a JPA attribute converter for the LoanTransactionType enum, allowing it to be persisted as an Integer in the database and converted back to its enum form when retrieved.

classes.name: LoanTransactionTypeConverter
classes.description: A JPA attribute converter that handles conversion between LoanTransactionType enum and Integer database representation.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts LoanTransactionType enum to its integer value for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts integer database value back to LoanTransactionType enum.
